notes.title: Notice of Update on Thursday, May 29, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and trouble caused to our players.

We will be releasing an update patch addressing the following issues on Thursday, May 29, 2025 at 7 AM UTC.

● Issues resolved in this update 
- Special move animations may not display correctly in certain situations.
- Other minor issues.

With this update, all major issues that have been identified so far have been resolved. 
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused over an extended period of time, and we appreciate your patience and understanding. Thank you for your continued support.

We hope you will continue to enjoy THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH moving forward.

notes.content:

We will be releasing an update patch addressing the following issues on Thursday, May 1, 2025 at 7 AM UTC.

● Issues resolved in this update 
- Display settings in the Options menu may not be applied correctly.
- Players may not be able to start matches in online rooms when network conditions are poor.
- Other minor issues.

Other major issues that are currently being investigated (as of April 25, 2025):
- Under certain conditions, the animation for a move may not display properly.
- The game may not work properly if sent to the background during an online match.

We are actively investigating and working to resolve these issues.
Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience and understanding.

We hope you will continue to enjoy THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH moving forward.

notes.title: Notice of Update on Monday, April 7, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and trouble caused to our players.
 
We will be releasing an update patch addressing the following issues on Monday, April 7, 2025 at 7 AM UTC.
 
● Issues resolved in this update
- Instances of significant slowdown during online battles. 
- Framerate during battles not being locked at 60 FPS, which could cause characters to move faster than they should. 
- Extremely high CPU utilization causing the game to run unstably.
  
Other major issues that are currently being investigated (as of April 7, 2025): 
- Display settings in the Option menu may not be applied correctly.
- The game may not work properly if sent to the background during an online match.
- Players may not be able to start matches in online rooms when network conditions are poor.
 
We are actively investigating and working to resolve these issues.
Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience and understanding.

We hope you will continue to enjoy THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH moving forward.

notes.title: Regarding Online Play in THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH (Steam Version)
notes.content:
We would like to apologize for the rollback netcode issues present in the Steam version of THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH.

Despite our resolve to address this situation swiftly, the time required to troubleshoot the issue took longer than expected.
We would now like to both present to players our plans to resolve the network issues, and offer our deepest apologies for the lack of communication regarding this issue so far.

We are actively investigating the issue and developing an update aimed at improving the situation for players. The plan is to roll out the update within the next 30 days.

■Planned Update Details:
1. The background stage elements of online matches will be made static in order to lessen rollback netcode strain.
2. Some stages that demand large amounts of resources will no longer be selectable when playing online.

Beyond this update, we are committed to continuing work on improving the online experience of the title, and will announce further updates and adjustments in the future.


When the above planned update is rolled out, there will be a short maintenance period in which online functions will be unavailable.
We ask for your understanding and patience during the downtime.

More information regarding the timing of this update will be announced on our official X account (@SNKPOfficial) in due course.
To all players of THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH, we thank you for your patience as we work to provide the satisfying online experience you deserve.
